# Yanstd (Muhammad Dian)

Independent builder dari Batam, Indonesia. Membangun dan memakai sendiri semua produknya.

## Proyek utama
- 9RouterX: AI gateway lokal open source (Go + Svelte 5, per-key governance, circuit breaker, semantic cache). https://github.com/yanstd888/9routerx
- humanizer-lint: linter prose anti-nada-AI, lokal, 8 bahasa, zero dependency. https://github.com/yanstd888/humanizer-lint
- Institutional SMC Scalper MT5: Expert Advisor XAUUSD non-martingale, backtest real-tick 6.5 tahun. https://github.com/yanstd888/institutional-smc-scalper-mt5
- AICLUB Free Subdomains: subdomain .ai.id dan TLD lain gratis. https://aiclub.ai.id
- Node2Mint: marketplace AI self-hosted dengan token billing. https://github.com/yanstd888/node2mint
